result:
The de-duplication was reworked in PR #3374 (commit `d47d346c`), which replaced the flatName-keyed merge with a multiset-max union of observations. The server-side ticket is not recoverable from the evidence I could reach, so I left it out of the array rather than guess a key.

**What changed**

- **The original problem and first fix (PR #3345, commit `16600fbf`).** Each order for a test produced its own branch in the `/obstree` response, each carrying the same observation. The first fix keyed de-duplication on `conceptUuid`. A second commit in the same PR scoped that key to the rendered panel, so a concept under two roots, such as Platelets under Hematology and Bloodwork, stays as two rows. The panel key comes from a shared `deriveGroupKey` helper.
- **The rework (PR #3374, commit `d47d346c`).** Two places changed:
  - `filter-reducer.ts`: `INITIALIZE` no longer concatenates obs lists when tests share a flatName. It merges them with `mergeObsMultisetMax`, which keeps the higher count of each `obsDatetime|value` identity across the two lists. The node is copied so the SWR-cached trees are not mutated.
  - `filter-context.tsx`: `normalizedTests` collapses branches by `${groupKey}_${conceptUuid}` and merges their obs with the same multiset-max union. Table rows, timeline and both result counts all derive from this list.
- **The stated limitation.** The reducer comment says `obsDatetime + value` is the best identity available "until the backend exposes obs uuids". Two genuinely separate results with the same value and time therefore still collapse when they only appear in separate lists. That proposed server-side change is to expose obs uuids in `/obstree`, so clients can tell copies apart.

**What I could not establish**

- The ticket key. Neither commit body (`d47d346c` has an empty body, `16600fbf` names no ticket) nor a search of the chart repo and `openmrs-module-webservices.rest` surfaced one. The PR #3374 description would likely have it, but I have no access to PR text through these tools.
- The webservices.rest change itself. No commit or code in the indexed repositories shows the backend exposing obs uuids in `/obstree`.

The answering change is `d47d346c`, and the ticket is still unknown.

**Evidence, best first**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-reducer.ts:11-39` — `mergeObsMultisetMax` and the documented limitation about obs uuids.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-reducer.ts:129-142` — `INITIALIZE` merging same-flatName tests with the multiset union.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-context.tsx:113-149` — `normalizedTests` collapsing branches per panel and concept.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-context.tsx:39-57` — `deriveGroupKey` and the `NormalizedBranch` description.
- Commit `16600fbf` (PR #3345) — the earlier `conceptUuid` key and the panel-scoped follow-up.
